source_defined_treatments.autogamy: all pollinators excluded with an organza bag
source_defined_treatments.bird_exclusion: birds excluded; insects and lizards allowed
source_defined_treatments.lizard_exclusion: lizards excluded; insects and birds allowed

claim_boundary: This is one Balearic island population and one plant species. QNC and QLC may be compared within the source-defined experiment, but the population is not an independent archipelago replicate of every other Balearic study and the source does not establish historical floral evolution. Autogamy is a direct reproductive-assurance channel for this population but is not numerically transported to Izu without an estimand-compatibility review.
